chunks: Some of our companions narrated to me from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no objection to performing wudu (ablution) with water that is placed in the sun.

key_terms.بِالْمَاءِ: with water, the substance used for purification
key_terms.فِي الشَّمْسِ: in the sun; exposed to sunlight
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no objection or harm; an expression of permissibility

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform wudu with water that has been left in the sun?
ai.summary: This hadith states that using water left in the sun for wudu (ablution) is permissible. It addresses a practical ruling in ritual purity and indicates that such water does not become unsuitable for purification merely by being heated or placed in sunlight.
